result_preview.title: Product Cost and Complexity Analytics
result_preview.shortDescription: Aggregated metrics on product cost drivers, BOM complexity, and supplier impact analysis.
result_preview.description: This analytical data product delivers aggregated cost and complexity metrics across product portfolios, integrating bill of materials depth, material sourcing patterns, and engineering change frequency. It enables procurement and engineering teams to identify high-cost drivers, optimize supplier qualification strategies, and track compliance documentation effectiveness across the product lifecycle.

result_preview.title: Engineering Change Impact Analytics
result_preview.shortDescription: Aggregates cost, complexity, and supplier impact metrics from engineering changes and material modifications.
result_preview.description: Synthesizes engineering change data with material specifications and product item configurations to provide comprehensive impact analysis. Summarizes bill-of-materials complexity, supplier dependency metrics, and compliance exposure across all active product modifications. Delivers actionable insights on change propagation costs and regulatory alignment for informed decision-making.

result_preview.title: Product Material Economics and Regulatory Assessment
result_preview.shortDescription: Evaluates material expenditures, regulatory adherence, and engineering modification impacts on bill-of-materials structures.
result_preview.description: Consolidates product item specifications, material master records, and engineering change documentation to deliver comprehensive supply chain economic analysis, regulatory compliance exposure assessment, and supplier relationship metrics. Enables finance and operations teams to monitor cost trends by component, track compliance obligations, and understand supplier performance implications for strategic procurement and product development initiatives.
